instruments.notes: Participating costless collar entered October 2007 pursuant to Term Credit Agreement with Lender (unrelated counterparty, not named). Floor/put ($65.00/Bbl WTI NYMEX) covers ~75% of estimated crude oil production: 113,220 Bbls total volume hedged, 31,908 Bbls remaining as of 3/31/09. Ceiling/call ($83.50/Bbl WTI NYMEX) covers ~45% of same production: 67,935 Bbls total volume hedged, 19,146 Bbls remaining as of 3/31/09 (sub-instrument fair value $0). Basis differential between NYMEX and Wyoming Sweet posted price is not hedged. Not designated as a cash flow hedge (changes in fair value recognized in current earnings). Net derivative asset of $455,960 (Level 3 fair value) at 3/31/09 corresponds to the put/floor leg; hedge expires October 2009.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Term Credit Agreement (Oct 2007) required hedging crude oil production via a costless collar; derivatives not designated as cash flow hedges; no speculative derivative use.
